requirements.text: This specification applies to all parts for the Kessler Mobility Inverter Gen3 programme that Acme Components is invited to quote under RFQ KM-2026-0231, covering the six part families listed in section 2.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components quotes all six catalog families HSG, FST, SNS, CON, BRK and HRN.

requirements.text: In this document Buyer means Kessler Mobility, Supplier means Acme Components, and Part means any item supplied to a Buyer drawing or purchase order issued under this RFQ.
requirements.rationale: Definitions carry no technical or commercial commitment.

requirements.text: The Buyer documents prevail over every Supplier document, and Supplier quotation conditions, general terms and reservations have no effect unless the Buyer accepts them in writing.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components quotes subject to its standard terms; excluding them entirely is a legal exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier quotation shall remain valid for 180 calendar days from the response due date.
requirements.rationale: No catalog limit on quotation validity.

requirements.text: Start of production is planned for March 2028; the Supplier shall confirm tooling and capacity for this date.
requirements.rationale: Tooling 16 weeks plus series 6 weeks fits a March 2028 start.

requirements.text: Aluminium die-cast inverter housings shall operate continuously from -40 C to +150 C.
requirements.rationale: HSG operating temperature -40 to +150 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: Housings for the silicon carbide power stage shall operate continuously at a coolant-side temperature of +175 C.
requirements.rationale: HSG operating temperature tops out at +150 C; +175 C cannot be met.

requirements.text: Housing castings shall achieve a tensile strength of at least 280 MPa.
requirements.rationale: HSG tensile strength is 240 MPa min; 280 MPa cannot be met.

requirements.text: Housings shall withstand 720 h of neutral salt spray with no corrosion penetrating the coating.
requirements.rationale: HSG salt spray 720 h meets 720 h.

requirements.text: Sealed housings shall meet ingress protection IP6K9K in the fully assembled condition.
requirements.rationale: HSG ingress IP6K9K meets the contract.

requirements.text: The sealing face of each housing shall be flat within 0.15 mm and within 0.05 mm over any 25 mm length.
requirements.rationale: HSG flatness 0.15 mm is met; the local 0.05 mm requirement is not in the contract.

requirements.text: Coolant jackets shall pass a leak test at the pressure and medium defined in the Buyer test sheet, which the Buyer will issue after nomination.
requirements.rationale: Pressure and medium are not stated and need Buyer input.

requirements.text: Class 10.9 forged steel fasteners shall have a tensile strength of at least 1040 MPa.
requirements.rationale: FST tensile 1040 MPa min meets the contract.

requirements.text: Fasteners shall carry a zinc-nickel coating applied to the Buyer coating specification.
requirements.rationale: FST zinc-nickel coating is the catalog coating.

requirements.text: Coated fasteners shall withstand 1000 h of salt spray to red rust.
requirements.rationale: FST salt spray is 480 h to red rust; 1000 h cannot be met.

requirements.text: Fasteners shall retain their rated properties from -40 C to +200 C.
requirements.rationale: FST operating temperature -40 to +200 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall provide hydrogen embrittlement baking records for every coating lot with a retained test sample.
requirements.rationale: Baking records exist; retained samples per lot are not standard practice.

requirements.text: PA66-GF30 sensor housings shall operate from -40 C to +125 C.
requirements.rationale: SNS operating temperature -40 to +125 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: Sensor housings shall meet ingress protection IP69K.
requirements.rationale: SNS ingress is IP67, not IP69K.

requirements.text: Metallic inserts and coated surfaces of sensor housings shall withstand 240 h of salt spray.
requirements.rationale: SNS salt spray 240 h meets 240 h.

requirements.text: Sensor housings shall be moulded from glass-fibre reinforced polyamide 66 with 30 percent glass content.
requirements.rationale: SNS material is PA66-GF30.

requirements.text: Sensor housings shall pass the vibration profile in the Buyer test specification, which is still in draft.
requirements.rationale: The vibration profile is in draft and needs Buyer input.

requirements.text: Terminal and connector assemblies shall operate from -40 C to +125 C.
requirements.rationale: CON operating temperature -40 to +125 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: Connector assemblies shall meet ingress protection IP67 when mated.
requirements.rationale: CON ingress IP67 meets the contract.

requirements.text: Connector assemblies shall carry a rated current of 30 A, and a busbar variant shall be rated at 50 A.
requirements.rationale: CON rated current 30 A is met; a 50 A busbar variant is not in the contract.

requirements.text: Connector assemblies shall withstand 10000 cycles of mating and unmating.
requirements.rationale: CON 10000 mating cycles meets the contract.

requirements.text: Connector assemblies of the high-voltage interface shall meet ingress protection IP69K when mated.
requirements.rationale: CON ingress is IP67, not IP69K.

requirements.text: Ductile iron brake caliper brackets shall achieve a tensile strength of at least 500 MPa.
requirements.rationale: BRK tensile 500 MPa min meets the contract.

requirements.text: Brackets shall withstand 480 h of salt spray.
requirements.rationale: BRK salt spray 480 h meets 480 h.

requirements.text: Brackets mounted near the brake disc shall operate at temperatures up to +220 C.
requirements.rationale: BRK operating temperature tops out at +180 C.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall provide fatigue life data for brackets to the Buyer load spectrum.
requirements.rationale: Tensile data exists; fatigue data to the Buyer spectrum needs new testing.

requirements.text: The bracket coating system shall be agreed with the Buyer paint shop before the first sample submission.
requirements.rationale: The coating system is not defined and needs Buyer input.

requirements.text: Wiring harness sub-assemblies shall operate from -40 C to +105 C.
requirements.rationale: HRN operating temperature -40 to +105 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: Harness connectors shall meet ingress protection IP67 at the connector.
requirements.rationale: HRN ingress IP67 at connector meets the contract.

requirements.text: Every harness sub-assembly shall pass a 100 percent end-of-line electrical test before shipment.
requirements.rationale: HRN 100 percent end-of-line electrical test meets the contract.

requirements.text: The end-of-line test shall include a functional check at both temperature limits of the harness.
requirements.rationale: Electrical test is 100 percent; a functional check at temperature limits is not standard.

requirements.text: Harness sub-assemblies for the e-axle zone shall operate continuously at +150 C.
requirements.rationale: HRN operating temperature tops out at +105 C.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall submit a material data sheet through the IMDS system for every Part before first sample submission.
requirements.rationale: Material declarations are part of standard PPAP practice.

requirements.text: All Parts shall comply with the REACH and RoHS regulations and the Supplier shall provide a written declaration on request.
requirements.rationale: Catalog materials are declared as REACH and RoHS compliant.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall maintain an environmental management system certified to ISO 14001 at every producing site.
requirements.rationale: ISO 14001 is held at Pune and Brno.

requirements.text: Aluminium castings shall contain at least 50 percent recycled content; the Buyer will define whether pre-consumer scrap counts.
requirements.rationale: Whether pre-consumer scrap counts is not stated and needs Buyer input.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall provide a product carbon footprint declaration for each part family once a year.
requirements.rationale: A yearly footprint declaration is feasible.

requirements.text: Packaging materials shall be recyclable and free of single-use plastics where technically feasible.
requirements.rationale: Standard Acme Components packaging is recyclable.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid IATF 16949 certificate covering every site that produces Parts under this RFQ.
requirements.rationale: IATF 16949 is held at Pune and Brno.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate for all producing sites.
requirements.rationale: ISO 9001 is held.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid ISO 45001 certificate for occupational health and safety.
requirements.rationale: ISO 45001 is held.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid TISAX AL3 label for information security before the nomination decision.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components holds TISAX AL2 only; AL3 is not held.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall provide an ISO 26262 process certificate for the development of safety-related Parts.
requirements.rationale: No ISO 26262 process certification is held.

requirements.text: A third production plant shall be certified to IATF 16949 before start of production as a back-up source.
requirements.rationale: IATF 16949 is not held at a third plant.

requirements.text: Production part approval shall be submitted at PPAP level 5 for all Parts, including on-site review at the Supplier.
requirements.rationale: PPAP levels 4 and 5 are not supported.

requirements.text: PPAP level 3 documents shall be submitted within ten days of the first sample submission.
requirements.rationale: Level 3 is supported; the ten-day submission window is shorter than standard.

requirements.text: Delivered quality shall be below 25 PPM, measured monthly per part number.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components PPM is under 50; below 25 PPM cannot be committed.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall deliver a complete 8D report within 5 working days of a quality complaint.
requirements.rationale: 8D within 10 working days is standard; an interim report within 5 days is possible.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall submit a control plan and a process FMEA for each Part with the PPAP package.
requirements.rationale: Control plan and PFMEA are standard PPAP items.

requirements.text: The tooling lead time from tooling order to first sample shall not exceed 12 weeks.
requirements.rationale: Tooling lead time is 16 weeks; 12 weeks cannot be met.

requirements.text: The series lead time from release to delivery shall not exceed 6 weeks.
requirements.rationale: Series lead time 6 weeks meets the contract.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall deliver under Incoterms 2020 FCA at the named Supplier site.
requirements.rationale: FCA is supported.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall deliver all series Parts under Incoterms 2020 DDP, including import duties at the Buyer plants.
requirements.rationale: DDP is not supported.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall also quote delivery under Incoterms 2020 DAP at the Buyer assembly plant.
requirements.rationale: DAP is supported.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall exchange delivery schedules and despatch advices with the Buyer through EDIFACT EDI messages.
requirements.rationale: EDI via EDIFACT is supported.

requirements.text: In addition to EDIFACT messages, the Supplier shall confirm each order line through the Buyer web portal API.
requirements.rationale: EDIFACT is supported; a Buyer portal API integration is not in the catalog.

requirements.text: Parts shall be shipped in returnable packaging defined in the Buyer packaging standard, which will be issued after nomination.
requirements.rationale: The packaging standard is not yet issued and needs Buyer input.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall absorb volume changes of plus or minus 20 percent within the series lead time.
requirements.rationale: Flexibility inside the 6 week lead time is limited and needs a frozen window.

requirements.text: Liquidated damages for late delivery shall be charged at the actual loss of the Buyer, without a cap.
requirements.rationale: Liquidated damages are accepted only up to 5 percent of the affected PO value; uncapped is an exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall grant an annual price reduction of 4 percent for 5 years from start of production.
requirements.rationale: Annual price-down is limited to 2 percent for 3 years; 4 percent is an exception.

requirements.text: Payment shall be made 90 days net from the date of a correct invoice.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components payment terms are net 60; net 90 is a commercial exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier warrants Parts against defects for 60 months with no mileage limit.
requirements.rationale: Warranty is 36 months or 100000 km; 60 months is an exception.

requirements.text: Supplier liability includes unlimited liability for indirect and consequential losses, including vehicle recall costs.
requirements.rationale: Only direct-damage liability is accepted; unlimited consequential-loss liability is an exception.

requirements.text: Tooling paid for by the Buyer remains the property of the Buyer and shall be marked as such.
requirements.rationale: Buyer-paid tooling ownership is standard practice.

requirements.text: The Supplier grants the Buyer a perpetual, free licence to the Supplier background intellectual property used in the Parts.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components retains background IP; a free perpetual licence is a legal exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall accept the Buyer Supplier Code of Conduct in its current version.
requirements.rationale: Code of conduct is acceptable.

requirements.text: The Buyer may audit the Supplier and its sub-suppliers on 10 working days notice.
requirements.rationale: Audit rights on notice are acceptable.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall disclose its cost breakdown on request; the Buyer will define the level of detail in a template.
requirements.rationale: The cost template is not defined and needs Buyer input.

requirements.text: Prices are fixed for the entire series life of the programme and shall not be adjusted for raw material, energy or currency movements.
requirements.rationale: Fixed pricing with no indexation is outside Acme Components commercial practice.

requirements.text: Prices are quoted in euro per piece and include packaging and the delivery obligation of the agreed Incoterm.
requirements.rationale: Standard price composition.

requirements.text: Payment shall be made 90 days net from the date of a correct invoice.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components payment terms are net 60; net 90 is a commercial exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall grant an annual price reduction of 4 percent on all series prices for 5 years from start of production.
requirements.rationale: Annual price-down is limited to 2 percent for 3 years; 4 percent is an exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall pay liquidated damages for late delivery equal to the actual loss of the Buyer, without a cap.
requirements.rationale: Liquidated damages are accepted only up to 5 percent of the affected PO value.

requirements.text: The warranty period is 60 months from the date of vehicle build, without a mileage limit.
requirements.rationale: Warranty is 36 months or 100000 km; 60 months is an exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier is liable without limit for indirect and consequential losses, including vehicle recall and field action costs.
requirements.rationale: Only direct-damage liability is accepted.

requirements.text: Tooling paid for by the Buyer is Buyer property; the Supplier maintains it at its own cost and insures it for replacement value.
requirements.rationale: Tooling custody and maintenance are standard practice.

requirements.text: Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information secret for fifteen years after the end of the supply relationship.
requirements.rationale: A fifteen-year confidentiality term is acceptable.

requirements.text: This agreement is governed by the law of the Buyer's seat; the competent court will be named in the purchase order.
requirements.rationale: The competent court is not stated and needs Buyer input.

requirements.text: Neither party is liable for delay caused by force majeure, provided it notifies the other party within five working days.
requirements.rationale: Standard force majeure clause.

requirements.text: The Buyer may terminate a purchase order for convenience on three months written notice; compensation is limited to finished goods.
requirements.rationale: Termination is acceptable; compensation limited to finished goods leaves open material uncovered.

requirements.text: Neither party may assign this agreement without the written consent of the other party.
requirements.rationale: Standard assignment clause.

requirements.text: Notices shall be in writing and sent to the contact addresses named in the purchase order.
requirements.rationale: Standard notices clause.

requirements.text: Confirm that Acme Components will quote all six part families named in section 2.
requirements.rationale: All six catalog families are quoted.

requirements.text: State the validated continuous operating temperature range of your aluminium die-cast housings.
requirements.rationale: HSG -40 to +150 C.

requirements.text: Confirm that your housings can operate continuously at +175 C coolant-side temperature.
requirements.rationale: HSG tops out at +150 C.

requirements.text: Do your coated fasteners reach 1000 h of salt spray to red rust?
requirements.rationale: FST reaches 480 h to red rust.

requirements.text: Do your PA66-GF30 sensor housings meet ingress protection IP69K?
requirements.rationale: SNS is IP67.

requirements.text: State the rated current of your standard connector assemblies and of any busbar variants.
requirements.rationale: Standard 30 A is held; busbar variants are not in the catalog.

requirements.text: Provide fatigue test reports for your brake caliper brackets.
requirements.rationale: Tensile data exists; fatigue reports to a Buyer spectrum need new testing.

requirements.text: Describe the end-of-line electrical test applied to harness sub-assemblies.
requirements.rationale: HRN 100 percent end-of-line electrical test.

requirements.text: Provide your IATF 16949 certificate number and expiry date for each plant.
requirements.rationale: IATF 16949 is held at both plants.

requirements.text: Provide your ISO 9001 certificate number and expiry date.
requirements.rationale: ISO 9001 is held.

requirements.text: Do you hold an ISO 45001 certificate? Provide the certificate details.
requirements.rationale: ISO 45001 is held.

requirements.text: Do you hold a valid TISAX AL3 label? Provide the label details.
requirements.rationale: TISAX AL2 is held; AL3 is not.

requirements.text: Do you hold an ISO 26262 process certificate? Provide the certificate details.
requirements.rationale: ISO 26262 process certification is not held.

requirements.text: Can you submit PPAP level 5 packages with an on-site review?
requirements.rationale: PPAP levels 4 and 5 are not supported.

requirements.text: State your delivered quality level in PPM over the last twelve months.
requirements.rationale: PPM is under 50; below 25 PPM is not committed.

requirements.text: Can you deliver series Parts under Incoterms 2020 DDP to the Buyer plants?
requirements.rationale: DDP is not supported.

requirements.text: Confirm that you can exchange EDI messages in EDIFACT format.
requirements.rationale: EDI via EDIFACT.

requirements.text: Which returnable packaging systems have you used for comparable Parts?
requirements.rationale: Packaging standard is not issued; the answer depends on Buyer input.

requirements.text: Confirm acceptance of uncapped liquidated damages for late delivery.
requirements.rationale: Only 5 percent of affected PO value is accepted.

requirements.text: Confirm acceptance of an annual price reduction of 4 percent for 5 years.
requirements.rationale: Only 2 percent for 3 years is accepted.

requirements.text: Confirm acceptance of a 60 month warranty without a mileage limit.
requirements.rationale: Warranty is 36 months or 100000 km.

requirements.text: Confirm acceptance of unlimited liability for indirect and consequential losses.
requirements.rationale: Only direct damages are accepted.

requirements.text: Confirm acceptance of the Buyer Supplier Code of Conduct.
requirements.rationale: Code of conduct is acceptable.

requirements.text: List the plants from which the Parts would be supplied.
requirements.rationale: Plants are Pune IN and Brno CZ.

requirements.text: Name your sales and quality contacts for this RFQ.
requirements.rationale: Administrative response.

requirements.text: Describe any assumptions or reservations attached to your quotation.
requirements.rationale: Depends on how the Buyer treats quotation reservations.
